column4: all such sums of money as may be received by the
Institute in the exercise, performance and discharge
of its powers, duties and functions under this Part;
all such sums of money as may be received by the
Institute by way of income, fees, charges, grants,
gifts  or  donations  from  any  source  whatsoever
whether within or outside Sri Lanka:
Provided  that,  the  Institute  shall  obtain  the
prior written approval of the Department of External
Resources of the Ministry of the Minister assigned
the  subject  of  Finance,  in  respect  of  all  foreign
grants, gifts or donations made to the Institute.
